# Scorpion Golf Cart Rental

> Scorpion Golf Cart Rental (also known as Scorpion Golf Carts) rents 4-seater and 6-seater golf carts to visitors in San Pedro, Ambergris Caye, Belize, with free delivery and pickup at hotels, resorts, and Airbnb rentals in San Pedro.

## Key facts

- Business: Scorpion Golf Cart Rental
- Website: https://www.scorpiongolfcarts.com/
- Location: San Pedro, Ambergris Caye, Belize
- Service: Golf cart rental (4-seater and 6-seater)
- Starting rates: from $35 per day (4-seater) and from $65 per day (6-seater); final quote depends on dates and cart
- Delivery: free delivery and pickup at hotels, resorts, and Airbnbs in San Pedro; San Pedro airstrip (SPR) pickup by arrangement
- Cancellation: free cancellation up to 24 hours before the rental starts
- Payment: cash and major credit and debit cards
- Hours: open 24 hours, every day
- Phone and WhatsApp: +501 600-7672 (https://wa.me/5016007672)
- Booking: online booking request at https://www.scorpiongolfcarts.com/, by phone, or by WhatsApp
- Instagram: https://www.instagram.com/scorpiongolfcarts
- TikTok: https://www.tiktok.com/@scorpiongolfcarts
